name: @streamdeck-supervisor/app
description: Local Stream Deck Neo supervisor for Codex and Claude
author: Shaun Wang

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package: npm run build:icon && npm run build:menu-bar && npm run build && electron-forge package --arch=arm64
scripts.make: npm run build:icon && npm run build:menu-bar && npm run build && electron-forge make --arch=arm64
scripts.package:mas: npm run build:icon && npm run build:menu-bar && npm run build && AGENT_PULSE_MAS=1 electron-forge package --platform=mas --arch=arm64
